visualCharacteristics.purpose: sub-page navigation of a topic: eyebrow, topic title and its pages, the current page bold
traits: from 768px at the top right of the content, 25% of the column; the rest of the page 75%
rows with a 1px grey line, 18px text and a chevron; the current page bold without chevron

contentPattern.structure: One cell: optional eyebrow paragraph, optional heading (topic), a list of links (the current page as plain or bold text)

usage.description: Info pages with the Lufthansa sub-page navigation (nav.subpage in .container-subnav, .has-subnav), 180 pages.

reuseGuidance: Use for the list of sibling pages of a topic beside the content. For a tab bar under the header use profile-nav.
